cs.t: I've used a Tread Desk (1) treadmill daily for many years with no maintenance or issues. Just sold it recently before a cross country move. Mine lacked any data integration, but that may be available in the newer models. It's just a flat, low gear treadmill with a control head on a cable, so you can use it with any standing desk or engineering cart. 1.  http://www.treaddesk.com/
